sql.query: SELECT w.id,w.templateId,w.ownerTeamId,w.currentStageId,ws.stageName fromStageName,ws.nextWorkflowStageId,nextStage.stageName toStageName,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) blockingTaskCount,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('waiting','internal_hold','external_hold') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) onHoldTaskCount,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.responseRequired=1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.responseValue),'') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) missingResponseCount,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND (r.tenantId IS NULL OR r.tenantId=ut.tenantId) INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND p.permissionCode='tenant.workflow.stage.approve') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.userTenantId=ut.id AND tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.teamId=w.ownerTeamId AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_roles tr ON tr.id=tmr.teamRoleId AND tr.teamId=tm.teamId AND tr.tenantId=tm.tenantId AND tr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=tr.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.workflow.stage.approve' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId2 AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') AS UNSIGNED) canApprove FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages ws ON ws.id=w.currentStageId AND ws.workflowId=w.id AND ws.tenantId=w.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages nextStage ON nextStage.id=ws.nextWorkflowStageId AND nextStage.workflowId=w.id AND nextStage.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_tasks t ON t.workflowStageId=ws.id AND t.workflowId=w.id AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isRequired=1 WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId3 AND w.currentStageId=:expectedStage AND ws.nextWorkflowStageId=:targetStage GROUP BY w.id,ws.id,nextStage.id LIMIT 1

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages SET status='complete',completedDate=COALESCE(completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:stageId AND workflowId=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages SET status=CASE WHEN status='not_started' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END,startedDate=COALESCE(startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:stageId AND workflowId=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId
